Explanations (S9-S11) logically connect revenue decreases to specific operational factors without conflicting with profitability improvements. The organization flows logically from consolidated performance to segment details and financial position. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity. While segment figures (e.g., S12) are not consolidated, the candidate does not claim they should sum to group totals, so no arithmetic contradictions arise under the specified safeguards.
